products.title: Systane Ultra Lubricant Eye Drops
products.detailedDescription: Systane Ultra provides long-lasting relief for dry eyes with extended protection. This preservative-free formula helps restore the natural tear film and provides comfort for up to 12 hours. Perfect for computer users and those experiencing digital eye strain.

products.title: Blue Light Blocking Glasses
products.description: Computer glasses for eye strain relief
products.detailedDescription: Professional blue light blocking glasses designed to reduce eye strain, headaches, and improve sleep quality. Features anti-glare coating and UV protection. Ideal for extended computer use and gaming sessions.

products.title: TheraTears Eye Drops
products.detailedDescription: TheraTears provides immediate and long-lasting relief for dry, irritated eyes. This unique electrolyte-balanced formula mimics natural tears and helps restore the eye's natural moisture balance. Safe for everyday use.

products.title: Computer Monitor Light Bar
products.description: Screen light to reduce eye strain
products.detailedDescription: Professional monitor light bar that provides optimal lighting for computer work while reducing screen glare and eye strain. Features adjustable brightness and color temperature to match your work environment throughout the day.

products.title: Omega-3 Eye Health Supplements
products.description: Support for dry eyes and vision health
products.detailedDescription: Premium omega-3 supplements specifically formulated for eye health. Contains EPA and DHA to support tear production and reduce inflammation. Clinically proven to help with dry eye symptoms and overall eye health maintenance.

problemPoints: Employees spend 6-10 hours daily in front of screens.
Digital eye strain causes headaches, fatigue, and poor focus.
Vision discomfort is a top factor in productivity loss.
beforeRescueEyes: 1 in 3 employees report daily headaches or eye discomfort
Average 20-40 minutes of lost productivity per person per day
afterRescueEyes: Higher engagement scores in wellness surveys
Documented reduction in sick leave related to eye strain
